William Edgar Brissey  
Independent AI Systems Architect, Developer, and Consultant

I review **one bounded LangSmith or LangGraph export** and return a signed written opinion: what the file shows, what I infer, what I will not claim.

I do not replace your tracer. I do not change your systems. I do not take a login. A model may draft. I adjudicate and sign.

This page is an offer overview. It is not the engagement agreement.

## When this is the right door

- A production or client-facing agent already traces to LangSmith or LangGraph.
- One incident window is costing time, money, or a client relationship.
- You can export runs as a file, or you can say plainly that you cannot.

## When it is not

- You need a patch installed, production access, or a certificate.
- The only artifact is screenshots or someone else's GitHub issue.
- You want every agent in the company reviewed as one job.

## What happens first

Fifteen minutes. **No file on that call.**

If there is no export yet, the next paid step is requested as scope (Export Clinic or Readiness Audit) — not forced as a Diagnostic.
